title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: operators and SREs need better visibility into burst consumption and the interaction between token-bucket based burst credits and short-term throughput guarantees for Dedicated fleets. This PR adds richer utilization reporting and a small set of metrics that make it possible to track burst credit usage, per-fleet effective throughput during bursts, and queueing impact when bursts are exhausted.

Summary of changes: adds new Prometheus metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens_total, dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens_used, dedicated_autoscaler_effective_throughput, dedicated_autoscaler_burst_queue_duration_seconds), instruments the tokenbucket smoothing code path to emit burst usage, exposes a new /fleet-utilization endpoint on the autoscaler admin API (read-only) that returns summarized utilization for a fleet over a configurable window, and updates the autoscaler evaluator to include burst-aware utilization in its decision loop. Includes small documentation and console dashboard wiring to surface the new metrics.

Implementation notes: the tokenbucket implementation was refactored to separate accounting from enforcement so reporting hooks could be added without changing enforcement semantics. We added a lightweight ring buffer (in-memory) to produce fast aggregated stats for the /fleet-utilization endpoint to avoid expensive historical queries in hot paths. All new metrics are prefixed with dedicated_autoscaler_ and follow existing label conventions (fleet_id, region, instance_type). The API and metrics are guarded behind a feature flag (autoscaler.enhanced_burst_reporting) to allow staged rollout.

Testing and CI: unit tests added for token accounting, integration test that spins up a small dedicated autoscaler + fake fleet to validate metrics during synthetic burst traffic, and end-to-end smoke that exercises the admin endpoint. CI runs: lint, unit, integration, e2e; all checks passed after a flaky e2e re-run.

Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag -> enable for internal staging fleets for 48h -> validate dashboards/alerts -> enable gradually for Dedicated customers. If higher-than-expected load on the admin endpoint is observed, fall back to sampling mode controlled by a config knob.

Related: ENG-3421 tracks the broader autoscaler stability work; PM-88 captures the product acceptance criteria for utilization dashboards. SUP-712 is a support request that motivated the initial observability gap.

Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] docs, [x] changelog entry, [x] staged rollout plan.

Add Prometheus metrics for burst tokens and effective throughput (asha/add-burst-metrics)
Expose /fleet-utilization admin endpoint and ringbuffer aggregator (asha/add-fleet-utilization-api)
Feature flag gating and integration tests (asha/feat-flag-burst-reporting)

review_comments: Miguel Torres: left nits about metric cardinality and suggested using fleet_id hash for high-cardinality fleets — addressed in commit asha/add-burst-metrics (reply: thanks, switched to fleet_shard label with bounded cardinality)
Priya Singh: asked for performance numbers for the ring buffer aggregator — replied with microbenchmarks (latency < 200µs per update) and added a comment in aggregator.go with complexity notes
Evan Chen: requested the feature flag and staged rollout plan; asked to ensure admin endpoint is read-only and rate-limited — added rate limiter with default 10r/s and documented behavior
ci_checks: e2e: pass (flaky first run, re-run passed)
merge_notes: Merged after approvals from Miguel, Priya, and Evan. Feature gated behind autoscaler.enhanced_burst_reporting. Verified dashboards in staging.
release_notes: Adds enhanced burst utilization metrics and a fleet-utilization admin endpoint for Dedicated autoscaler. Feature gated; opt-in rollout recommended.
console_changes: New prebuilt dashboard 'Dedicated Burst Overview' that surfaces burst_tokens_used, effective_throughput, and burst_queue_duration; wiring added to metrics explorer.
rollback_plan: If the ringbuffer causes high memory or admin endpoint sees high QPS, toggle autoscaler.enhanced_burst_reporting=false and revert routing on monitoring agents. Alerts added to detect memory pressure on autoscaler pods.
notes_for_release: Enable feature flag in staging for 48h. Watch dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens_used and dedicated_autoscaler_burst_queue_duration_seconds for anomalies. Update customers via release notes if their SLA dashboards change.
